title: Rh(III)-catalyzed oxidative C–H annulation of 6-arylpyridazin-3(2H)-ones: direct access to diarylpyridazino[6,1-a]isoquinolin-5-ium-3-olates
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26078-26082
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01670G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chaitanya Ittamalla, N. S. S. Mukundram, Jyothirmai Nagireddy, B. Sridhar, B. V. Subba Reddy
A novel synthesis of pyridazino[6,1-a]isoquinolin-5-ium-3-olate derivatives is described using a Rh(III)/AgSbF6 catalytic system. This is the first report on ortho-C–H bond annulation of 6-arylpyridazin-3(2H)-ones with disubstituted alkynes.
